title: Daneel ailang_only executor with secret-safe Ollama web search

velocity.basis: Seam-based estimate with integration buffer; seven-day git history contains only the v0.39.1 release commit.

features.description: Bind policy ai_provider through the existing AI handler setup and reject every flag/cap cross-set that could widen or leave authority ambiguous.
acceptance_criteria: Policy with AI plus ai_provider=stub runs an AI-cap program without --ai.
--ai with --policy, AI without ai_provider, and ai_provider without AI all fail with stable named reasons.
Focused tests, make test-core, lint, and boundary checks pass.
features.notes: ai_provider bound into setupAIHandler via runPolicyResolved; --ai/--ai-stub refused under --policy; AI<->ai_provider cross-checks; admission line carries ai_provider. 3 binary tests, stub binding mutation-checked. Guide + changelog.

features.description: Add typed std/web webSearch and webFetch operations backed by fixed Ollama endpoints; the Go handler reads OLLAMA_API_KEY and exposes effect Net only.
acceptance_criteria: webSearch returns list records with title, url, content; webFetch returns title, content, links; both use existing NetError and effect Net only.
Recorded fixture tests cover success and failures, and assert sentinel key material cannot reach outputs, errors, traces, or fixtures.
Opt-in live control passes when OLLAMA_API_KEY and the explicit live flag are set and is skipped otherwise.
Runnable example, frozen interfaces/goldens, full tests, lint, and boundary checks pass.

features.description: Release the AILANG binary and stdlib contract containing ai_provider enforcement and std/web before fleet config consumes them.
acceptance_criteria: Published binary reports the new version and ailang iface std/web exposes both signatures.
Multivac image resolves the released version before registry configuration proceeds.
Release notes document the Net-only and secret-lending boundaries.

features.description: In ailang-multivac, add the daneel-executor registry entry, policy and template; bind the existing OLLAMA_API_KEY secret into pi Jobs and verify the rendered Job and a live probe.
acceptance_criteria: Registry pins z-ai/glm-5.3-flash on OpenRouter, uses ailang_only, and sets acknowledge_only=true.
Policy adds ollama.com, excludes Env and Msg, and retains narrowed git status/diff/log process authority.
Terraform plan and rendered Cloud Run Job contain a Secret Manager-backed OLLAMA_API_KEY env reference but no key material.
Container Job proves std/web works with Net and no Env; unlisted host, Env, and forbidden process controls fail.

features.description: In Daneel, add typed host dispatch/completion consumption and ext/search wrapping std/web with an Authority row exactly over Net.
acceptance_criteria: ext/search package type-checks and its Authority row is exactly [Net].
Recorded search/fetch smokes pass and preserve structured NetError failures.
Host validates Request, dispatches only to daneel-executor, correlates completion, and maps BLOCKED or malformed input structurally.
Package cannot choose a model, supply a secret, widen domains, or acquire Env/AI/Process authority.

features.description: Run the production round trip and negative boundary controls, then record cross-repository release, deployment, task, policy and non-leak evidence.
acceptance_criteria: A live Daneel request returns at least one real Ollama search result through a correlated completed task.
Banked evidence identifies GLM on OpenRouter and a non-empty policy digest, with no OLLAMA_API_KEY material in transcripts, summaries, or artifacts.
Env, unlisted-domain, and forbidden-process negative controls fail under named policy categories.
AILANG, multivac, and Daneel docs/changelogs plus a credential-free implementation report are complete.
